doc: Guideline: Daily iron and folic acid supplementation in pregnant women

entries.claim: 孕妇每日口服铁和叶酸补充剂可作为产前保健的一部分，以降低低出生体重、母亲贫血和缺铁的风险。
entries.source_doc: Guideline: Daily iron and folic acid supplementation in pregnant women

entries.claim: 孕期每日口服铁和叶酸补充剂可降低低出生体重、母体贫血和铁缺乏的风险
entries.source_doc: Guideline: Daily iron and folic acid supplementation in pregnant women

entries.claim: 孕期每日补铁可使新生儿低出生体重风险降低约19%
entries.source_doc: Guideline: Daily iron and folic acid supplementation in pregnant women

entries.claim: 孕期每日补铁可使孕妇足月贫血风险降低70%
entries.source_doc: Guideline: Daily iron and folic acid supplementation in pregnant women

entries.claim: 在孕妇贫血患病率≥40%的严重公共卫生问题地区，优先采用每日60 mg元素铁的补充剂量
entries.source_doc: Guideline: Daily iron and folic acid supplementation in pregnant women

entries.claim: 妊娠第一个月后开始补充叶酸不能预防神经管缺陷
entries.source_doc: Guideline: Daily iron and folic acid supplementation in pregnant women

entries.claim: 孕期每日补充铁和叶酸有助于预防重要的健康问题，其益处远大于危害。
entries.section: Summary of the considerations by the Nutrition Guidance Expert Advisory Group for determining the strength of the recommendation
